hinglish_screen_text: Unka ek yoddha gira. Raasta khul raha hai, Maharaj.
hindi_voice_text: उनका एक योद्धा गिरा। रास्ता खुल रहा है, महाराज।
english_voice_text: One of theirs is down. The way is opening, Maharaj.
note: Approved by the Commander, 31 Oct 2026. Replaces 'Hamari pankti aage badh rahi hai.' — the old line reported a fact with no weight; this says what changed on the field and why it matters. Hindi re-recorded? No — still needs Bulbul.

hinglish_screen_text: Unhone Vayavyastra chalaya — do mohre jagah badal gaye. Jo pehchana tha, dobara parakhiye.
hindi_voice_text: उन्होंने वायव्यास्त्र चलाया — दो मोहरे जगह बदल गए। जो पहचाना था, दोबारा परखिए।
english_voice_text: They called the wind. Two of their pieces traded places — what you knew of them may be wrong now.
note: Approved by the Commander, 31 Oct 2026. Replaces 'Unki taraf hawa chali. Unke do mohre jagah badal chuke hain.' — the wind now does something and the player is told what it costs them. Hindi re-recorded? No — still needs Bulbul.
